earnings.title: Media Investor Relations
highlights: Earnings per share (EPS) of $2.40, down 20% due to one-time gain in prior year; adjusted EPS 1 of $2.27, up 34%
Sales of $5.0 billion, up 1% reported (7% organic 1 ) driven by broad-based growth across all segments
Operating margin of 14.8%, up 640 basis points; segment margin 1 of 21.3%, up 370 basis points
Operating cash of $0.6 billion; free cash flow 1 of $0.7 billion, with conversion 1 of 95%

The company reported third-quarter sales of $5.0 billion, up 1% reported and 7% organic 1 , driven by broad-based strength across all three segments, pricing actions, and continued demand across key end markets.

quotes.text: Honeywell Technologies delivered strong results across the business in our first quarter as a standalone company. Continued momentum across all three segments, together with our improving position in high-growth verticals, translated to 7% organic sales growth, above the three-year target set at our June Investor Day.
quotes.by: Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Vimal Kapur

outlook: Finally, operating cash flow and free cash flow are now expected to be ~$2.1 billion each.
